answer: We bind each identity to a bonded stake deposited at a distinct inlet of the registration tree, so a sybil must lock independent capital per leaf rather than reuse one jetty across aliases. Colluding clusters that reuse timber from a shared provenance pool are detected via non-collusive voting tree audits, and a dynamic penalty curve slashes their weight superlinearly. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
